ns2:course.label: Band Arranging
ns2:course.description: Development of basic scoring and arranging skills for various small instrumental ensembles and marching band. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208 or equivalent.
